messages.text: Make global system r-z plots with the two solenoid options, and add them to this PR, in general make an execute summary as part of the PR description each time

I’ll add full-detector r–z drawings for both solenoid options, showing the outer coil’s proposed envelope changes. I’ll also update the PR description with an executive summary and record that convention for future PRs.

The drawings include the tracker, calorimeters, muon hosts, and detached forward calorimeters on identical scales. The outer-solenoid option explicitly shows the muon barrel’s proposed inner-radius change from 4.35 to 4.95 m and the unused inner-coil reservation.

The drawings are generated and visually checked. Both layouts have zero positive rectangle overlaps, and each ideal current sheet lies within its coil reservation. I’ve also added the executive-summary requirement to `AGENTS.md` and the PR template so it carries forward to future PRs.

[PR #6](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/6) now begins with an executive summary and embeds the combined layout drawing, with links to individual PNG/SVG exports. The documentation checks and dashboard build passed; I’m checking CI on the final pushed revision.

Updated [PR #6](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/6) with:

- Full-system r–z drawings for both solenoid options, plus a combined comparison.
- Explicit outer-coil and muon-envelope changes.
- An executive summary with the main findings and review decisions.

Executive summaries are now required by `AGENTS.md` and the PR template.

Layout checks, documentation validation and CI passed.
